items.evidence: (b) and (c) are answered by a change of design (owner-116, 15.11.2026): the ruler class is the module's subclass, and every write of its `visible` asks one predicate (scripts/fog-doorways.mjs:1887-1911, hourRulerFor; set at visibility.mjs:52, rulerHere 1006-1011, rulerShownTo 940-947), so Foundry writing it on again is written off for a token this viewer may not see, and an un-hide shows it on the next write. hideMovementTrail's one-off write is still there (visibility.mjs:1013-1016, called from hide at 879). (a) is recorded as read on 14.365 on 03.09 (comment at visibility.mjs:911-917).
items.pinned_by: R7523 (tier 0, both shapes of `visible` on stand-in classes) and R7703 (tier 1, a veiled token's ruler)
items.still_wrong: Not read on v14: which shape `visible` has on the real ruler class and whether the path, the waypoints and the distance label all follow it, and what a second seat sees during a real drag - AUDIT 9.2 items 558 and 559 (LIVE-E116-01, LIVE-E116-02), open; no row for them in docs/dev/e58/LOCAL-REPORT.md (grep of E116 and 'ruler' finds none).
items.refutation_tried: Looked for a reading of the ruler in the two real-Foundry papers (docs/dev/e58/LOCAL-REPORT.md, docs/dev/e39/CALIBRATION.md): none.
items.note: The check's own wording ('nothing ever sets it back') is out of date: the rule is asked on every write now.

items.title: Live check 3: two quick crossings on a player's client before the GM's Eclipse count lands (canCross and movesLeft read the stale count); the same shape for freeMoveUsed on a fast double drag

items.title: Live check 4: restoreSceneVisionMode restores fog.mode only when the saved value is a finite number; if v14's CONST.FOG_MODES members are strings, turning the room fog off leaves Foundry's exploration fog disabled on every scene
items.old_state: listed in map.md only; no reading recorded
items.evidence: scripts/fog.mjs:974 is unchanged in shape: `if (Number.isFinite(before.fogMode)) update["fog.mode"] = before.fogMode;` (the value saved at 583 is scene.fog.mode as it stood). The writer of the 'off' value does not assume a number: fogDisabledValue (1095-1110) takes whatever the constant table holds and falls back to the string 'disabled'. Called for every scene when the setting is switched off (restoreScenes 994-1000, onFogSettingChanged 1115-1117).
items.pinned_by: none found (tier 2 calls restoreSceneVisionMode at tests-tier2.mjs:63662 and 68294 to tidy up after itself, on the harness's own scene data)
items.still_wrong: If v14 keeps fog.mode as a string: a GM switches the room fog setting off, each scene gets its token vision and global light back and keeps Foundry's fog exploration disabled, with the record of the old value deleted (unsetFlag at 985).
items.refutation_tried: Looked for a recorded value of CONST.FOG_MODES on v14: grep of FOG_MODES and fog.mode in audit/AUDIT-1.2.42.md, docs/dev/** finds none.
items.note: One console line settles it: `CONST.FOG_MODES` and `typeof canvas.scene.fog.mode` on 14.370.

new_observations.title: The real-Foundry reading of MAP-02 says 'hidden in the corridor' on a sample that lies inside the room left
new_observations.what: The row gives 'last hidden at x 588' as the corridor's sample. On the seeded map (audit/harness/lib/seed.mjs:120, 132-133) a 1x1 token at x 588 has its centre at 638, inside Dorm A (200-800); the corridor is the centre between 800 and 1200. The two samples it names bracket the corridor and neither is in it, so the row does not show what a viewer sees while the sprite is between the rooms.

new_observations.title: The comment over the sliding-sprite rule says more than its line does
new_observations.what: 'While the sprite is not yet in a room of mine it stays hidden' stands over `if (at && !myRooms().has(at)) hide(token)`, which holds the sprite only while it is in another room; in no room it is left to Foundry. The guard has been `at &&` since the fix's first commit (8d24e215).

not_established: MAP-02's standing part: whether Foundry 14.370 writes a sliding token's `visible` again on a frame that only moves it (the harness models a slide as refreshPosition alone, client-entry.mjs:1356-1365, marked LIVE-E88-05). If it does, a token crossing a gap between two rooms is drawn there; if it does not, the token stays hidden from the room it left until some refresh of its visibility. Settled by: the sampling of LOCAL-REPORT.md:419 run again with a sample forced while the sprite's centre is between the two rooms (x 800-1200 on the seeded map), reading token.visible there; and once for a Monokuma.
